text: There is a haze off Route 9 most mornings and my youngest has started using an inhaler. I was told two months ago someone would look into monitoring and I have heard nothing. Does anyone measure the air where I live?
My assistance application has been under review for seven weeks and the status line has not changed once. The callback number disconnects after twenty minutes in the queue.

The benefits portal is not navigable with a screen reader. The eligibility wizard has unlabelled buttons and the session times out before I can work around it. I cannot apply for a benefit I qualify for.
I would like copies of the grant awards made in this district for the last two fiscal years, including award dates. This is a records request, not urgent, but I have asked twice.
Gas smell in the corridor of the county services building, second floor, near the west stairwell. Staff there said to report it online. It was still there when I left.
Your published flu figures are six weeks old and the dashboard link errors out. I run four schools and I am deciding whether to move two events this week.
I was charged a late penalty for a renewal that one of your offices told me was automatic. I have both letters. Please remove the penalty and tell me which office is right.
The parking at the north office has no accessible spaces marked since the resurfacing. I waited forty minutes for someone to move so I could get out of my vehicle.
Whoever redesigned the forms deserves credit. I filed in eight minutes on a phone. Sending this because you probably only hear the complaints.
A caseworker discussed my file loudly enough for the waiting room to hear, including my address. I want to know what the policy is and who I raise this with.
Flood water is coming up through the drain in the basement of my building and the emergency line is engaged. Three units down here. Please send someone.
I have been transferred four times trying to find out which form I need. Nobody can tell me. I am not angry, I am just going in circles.
The address you have on file for me is wrong and mail is going to a previous tenant. I have corrected it twice through the portal and it reverts.
Requesting the methodology behind the county air quality index figures published last month. I am a graduate student and happy to wait for the normal process.
My benefit stopped with no notice and rent is due Friday. I have two children. I do not know what happened or who to ask.
